addictionPotential: 长期使用会产生依赖且滥用潜力中等。
effectsSummary: DXM has dissociative, anesthetic, and mild psychedelic effects. Effects vary greatly by dose. Low doses: stimulation, euphoria. High doses: dissociation, hallucinations.
dosageRemark: DXM has multiple plateaus with distinct effects. Do not mix with other serotonergic drugs due to risk of serotonin syndrome.
generalRisks: Nausea, vomiting, dizziness, increased heart rate and blood pressure. At high doses: confusion, loss of coordination, risk of serotonin syndrome.
